response.sql: WITH observatory_counts AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), shares AS (SELECT telescope_count, 1.0 * telescope_count / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share FROM observatory_counts), compared AS (SELECT telescope_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(telescope_count) AS total_telescopes, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM compared WHERE share > average_share;
